title: PAR-134 TABLECONTENT skipped CMC style and content-format completeness gates
mode: generated AC1021 TABLECONTENT object-vector fast slice
scope: Prevent skipped TABLECONTENT cell content-format and cell-style data from being marked semantically complete
Keep structural TABLECONTENT parsing and following style-handle alignment intact
Qualify the documented populated-style discriminator before consuming its fields

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA documents content-format content color as CMC, cell-style background color as CMC, and border colors as CMC. It defines cell-style data flag 0 as absent and 1 as present. The local typed TABLECONTENT projection structurally consumes these style fields but does not retain them.

localCode.finding: skipTableContentFormat and skipTableCellStyle consume CMC-bearing style data; TABLE typed output is gated by m_semanticContentComplete, so successful structural skipping must not be reported as complete semantic retention.

productionSummary: Mark TABLECONTENT semantically incomplete when any content-format override or populated cell style is parsed but not retained.
Propagate semantic state through cell, column, row, and table cell-style parsing while continuing the bounded structural parse.
Reject cell-style data flag values greater than the ODA-defined 0/1 values.

generatedControls.wireAndParser: Locally authored AC1021 TABLECONTENT frames exercise a content-format CMC and a populated cell style containing background and content CMCs. Each control asserts a structurally complete read, a semantically incomplete result, and successful parse of the trailing TABLESTYLE hard pointer. Existing style-absent control remains complete.
generatedControls.evidenceBoundary: Generated vectors validate local bounded parsing and evidence classification only; they do not establish producer-authored TABLECONTENT CMC semantics or successful typed TABLE serialization for those fields.

evidenceLimits: The color/style payload remains parsed and discarded; the change prevents incomplete typed semantic output and preserves the existing fallback behavior.
